title: Nigeria Universities
description: Independently compiled factual reference data for the current National Universities Commission register of Nigerian universities. Each record represents one university listing in the federal, state or private category.
methodology: Independently compiled and cross-verified factual reference data from the public National Universities Commission university registers. The register was retrieved three times with consistent results on 2026-08-30. Observed counts: federal 77; state 69; private 182. SoftData compiled the current NUC-listed federal, state and private universities as the dataset boundary and normalized obvious typographical defects and former-name annotations in the public name only when supported by current official sources. The NUC register is mutable; these counts describe the verified snapshot and do not establish a universal institution identifier.
